description: Provenance ledger for every tracked data file in this repository.
This is a public repository: tracked data files must contain only
publicly releasable values. Allowed provenance categories:
pds-archived              - Mars 2020 instrument data within the
raw-images-feed           - product published on the public Mars 2020
CI --tree). Directory entries end with '/' and cover all files under
them; longest matching prefix wins. When a new PDS release extends an
instrument's archive, bump that instrument's pds_envelope block (and
any dependent cutoff configs) in the same change-set before adding
fixtures from newly released sols. See CONTRIBUTING.md 'Fixture

sherloc.source: PDS Geosciences node, Mars 2020 SHERLOC archive (Release 15 covers sols through 1739)
